name: SOKO Leipzig
description: SOKO Leipzig is a German police procedural television programme, a spin-off of the earlier German police programme SOKO 5113. It was first broadcast on 31 January 2001, on German television channel ZDF. On 12 November 2008, the first part of a two-part crossover between SOKO Leipzig and British police procedural The Bill was aired, with the same version being shown on both ZDF and British television channel ITV1.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hajo Trautzschke is invited to a reception because his daughter Leni will receive a price for her labor as journalist and has decided to go by tramway to the reception. In the center of the town two robbers make an holdup in a jewelry.

videos.title: Tief im Herzen
videos.overview: Shortly after the funeral of the deceased pensioner Gerda Moll, Pastor Palm is found murdered. Disagreements within the church lead the investigators to a suspect. But also the discovered family problems of the Moll family are riddles.
